units.source_text: 大約十年前，一個裝著筆記本和照片的郵包，寄到了京橋的店裡，

en.t: About ten years ago, a parcel containing notebooks and photographs was sent to the shop in Kyobashi,

units.source_text: 寄件人是小葉沒錯的，但郵包上卻沒有寫他的地址和名字。

en.t: The sender was certainly Oba, but neither his address nor his name was written on the parcel.

units.source_text: 大空襲時，郵包和其他東西混在一起，不可思議地逃過一劫，

en.t: During the great air raids, the parcel got mixed in with other things and somehow miraculously survived,

units.source_text: 前一陣子，我才把它讀完……」

en.t: and only recently did I finally finish reading it..."
"Did it make you cry when you read it?"

units.source_text: 「沒有，與其說哭，哎……怎麼說呢，廢了，

en.t: "No. Rather than making me cry, well... how should I put it, it was ruined,

units.source_text: 人要是變成那個樣子就廢了。」

en.t: once a person becomes like that, they are finished."

units.source_text: 「從那以後，十年都過去了，他也許已不在人世了吧。

en.t: "Ten years have passed since then, so perhaps he is no longer alive.

units.source_text: 毫無疑問這是作為對你的感謝，才特意寄給你的吧。

en.t: Without a doubt, he must have gone out of his way to send it to you as thanks.

units.source_text: 雖然個別處略顯言過其實的誇張，

en.t: Although there are places here and there that seem somewhat exaggerated,

units.source_text: 你似乎也受到了不少牽連和傷害吧。

en.t: it seems you too were caught up in it and hurt quite badly.
